_comment: Config for platform-mirror-audit. Edit these when clients/domains change.
_exclude_note: Domains we do NOT run cold outreach through on PlusVibe (HH-only warmup/parking). Excluded from BOTH gap directions.
_client_tag_note: Used only to place a whole-domain PV gap when the domain has no PlusVibe sibling to copy the workspace from. Tag values come from the `tags` column of the consolidated credential CSVs.
_credential_note: Directories scanned recursively for *.csv with email+password columns. Newest file wins on conflict.
